packages.name: linux-atm
packages.rebuild_reason: Drop the glibc-kernheaders virtual provide for kernel-headers < 7: kernel-headers 7 no longer ships linux/atmsvc.h, so the published 2.5.1-47 build is the one that failed on it and the one ppp's build root resolves linux-atm-libs-devel from. Release does not move, so without this counter the published NEVR still matches the recipe and the fix is skipped.

packages.name: samba
packages.rebuild_reason: Relink against Hummingbird ICU 78. 507b2bf made 78 the sole runtime ICU, but the published samba still requires libicuuc.so.77 and libicui18n.so.77, which no longer resolve; Release is %{samba_release}, a macro dist_bump refuses to guess at, so this entry change is what forces the rebuild.
